Every part of the character is solid and opaque with an ink outline: no soft glows, no smoke, no particles, no motion lines. BACKGROUND: flat solid chroma green (#00FF00) filling the entire image. No floor, no ground line, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no frame. Nothing green on the character.
